content: Only the SessionStart hook's stdout is added to the model's context. PreCompact and SessionEnd stdout are NOT injected — treat those as side-effect-only hooks (e.g. run a sync/push), and rely on SessionStart for any post-compaction context reload.
context: Verified against the Claude Code hooks docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md) during T-043. This revealed that zug's existing PreCompact→`zug compact` checkpoint print never reached the model (logged as ISS-042); post-compaction reload actually works via SessionStart/compact→`zug resume`. SessionStart matchers: startup, resume, clear, compact. SessionEnd fires once at session termination (vs Stop, per-turn).
title: PreCompact hook stdout is not injected into Claude Code context
